cast_top: Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly, Ed Harris, Paul Bettany
overview: From the heights of notoriety to the depths of depravity, John Forbes Nash Jr. experiences it all. But as the handsome and arrogant Nash accepts secret work in cryptography, he becomes entangled in a mysterious conspiracy. His life takes a nightmarish turn and he soon finds himself on a painful and harrowing journey of self-discovery.
tagline: He saw the world in a way no one could have imagined.

title: Paper Tiger
cast_top: Miles Teller, Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson, Gavin Goudey
overview: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.
tagline: All debts are paid in blood.

title: De Gaulle: Liberté
cast_top: Simon Abkarian, Niels Schneider, Thierry Lhermitte, Karim Leklou
overview: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
cast_top: Ozzy Osbourne, Tony Iommi, Geezer Butler, Bill Ward
overview: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

title: NAZA
cast_top: Yuval Abraham, Benjamin Netanyahu
overview: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
tagline: A window into systems of mass killing.

title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
cast_top: Brad Pitt, Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II
overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

title: Club Kid
cast_top: Jordan Firstman, Reggie Absolom, Cara Delevingne, Diego Calva
overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

title: Daffy Season
cast_top: Eric Bauza, Jeff Bergman, Gabriel Iglesias, Jeannie Tirado
overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.
tagline: A global celebration of soccer. A personal crisis for Daffy.

title: The Devils
cast_top: Vanessa Redgrave, Oliver Reed, Dudley Sutton, Max Adrian
overview: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of sexually depraved Sister Jeanne's accusations of witchcraft, which corrupt officials of church and state are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
tagline: Hell will hold no surprises for them...

title: Violent Night 2
cast_top: David Harbour, Kristen Bell, Daniela Melchior, Jared Harris
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.
tagline: ...and to all a good fight.

title: Bitter Christmas
cast_top: Bárbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Victoria Luengo
overview: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.

title: All of a Sudden
cast_top: Virginie Efira, Tao Okamoto, Kyōzō Nagatsuka, Kodai Kurosaki
overview: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.
tagline: One night. Two strangers. A lifetime of questions.

title: Madden
cast_top: Nicolas Cage, Christian Bale, John Mulaney, Kathryn Hahn
overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

title: Ray Gunn
cast_top: Sam Rockwell, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Waits, Matt Berry
overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.
tagline: The taller the skyscrapers, the longer the shadows.

title: Behemoth!
cast_top: Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, Will Arnett
overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.
tagline: A life. In pieces.

title: Minotaur
cast_top: Dmitriy Mazurov, Iris Lebedeva, Varvara Shmykova, Juris Žagars
overview: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.
tagline: Morality is a maze.

title: Steps
cast_top: Ali Wong, Amanda Seyfried, Stephanie Hsu, Bette Midler
overview: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.
tagline: At midnight, we ride.

title: Elsinore
cast_top: Andrew Scott, Olivia Colman, Billie Piper, Johnny Flynn
overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.
tagline: Live. Gloriously.

title: Flavia
cast_top: Molly Belle Wright, Martin Freeman, Toby Jones, Jonathan Pryce
overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.
tagline: A little genius goes a long way.

title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
cast_top: Chen Yiwen, Fu Chong, Churong Fan, Zhang Anqi
overview: Peppa is disappointed when she learns her family vacation is canceled. However, a sudden storm blows a hot air balloon carrying Peppa, George, Granny Pig, and Grandpa Pig all the way to China

title: Josephine
cast_top: Mason Reeves, Channing Tatum, Gemma Chan, Philip Ettinger
overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.
tagline: Too young to understand. Too old to forget.

title: The Muppets
cast_top: Jason Segel, Amy Adams, Chris Cooper, Rashida Jones
overview: When Kermit the Frog and the Muppets learn that their beloved theater is slated for demolition, a sympathetic human, Gary, and his felt-faced brother, Walter, swoop in to help the gang put on a telethon show and raise the $10 million they need to save the day.
tagline: Get ready for Muppet domination.

title: Hershey
cast_top: Finn Wittrock, Alexandra Daddario, Alan Ruck, Richard Kind
overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.
tagline: The true story of an American dreamer.

title: November 1963
cast_top: John Travolta, Robert Carlyle, Dermot Mulroney, Jefferson White
overview: Follows the 48 hours after the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, the alleged involvement of Sam Giancana and the 'Chicago Outfit', and a supposed broken promise after the mob helped to get Kennedy elected.
tagline: Betrayed by power. Fuelled by revenge.

title: The Vile
cast_top: Bdoor Mohammad, Sarah Taibah, Jasem Alkharraz, Samira Al-Wahaibi
overview: Devoted wife and mother Amani, whose life begins to unravel when her husband returns home with a second wife and an unseen darkness infiltrates her life.
tagline: Nothing is what it seems.

title: Lilo & Scratch
cast_top: Chris Sanders, Maia Kealoha
overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.
tagline: The ‘ohana is getting bigger.

title: Tangles
cast_top: Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Abbi Jacobson, Bryan Cranston, Samira Wiley
overview: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.
tagline: A story about Alzheimer’s, my mother and me.

title: The Fox
cast_top: Jai Courtney, Emily Browning, Olivia Colman, Claudia Doumit
overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

title: In Waves
cast_top: Rio Vega, Lyna Khoudri, Paul Kircher, Birane Ba
overview: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.
tagline: Like a storm, grief comes in waves.

title: Above the Below
cast_top: Idris Elba, Caitlin FitzGerald, Hero Fiennes Tiffin
overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.
tagline: Rise to survive.

title: ENE Repeat
cast_top: Vishwak Sen, Abhinav Gomatam, Venkatesh Kakumanu, Maganti Srinath
overview: Vivek and his gang of friends embark on an attempt to create an ambitious survival film.

title: Tender Loving Care
cast_top: Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson, Kate O'Flynn, Alice Bailey Johnson
overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
cast_top: John Aprea, Dan Perri, Gray Barnard, Keith Carradine
overview: An in-depth exploration into the life of Dan Perri, the man who created titles for some of the most iconic movies of all time.
tagline: Meet the man who made the first five minutes of 300 of your favorite movies.

title: Eternal Return
cast_top: Naomi Scott, Kit Harington, Sonoya Mizuno, Jay Lycurgo
overview: In this timeless romance, Cass (Naomi Scott) is resigned to a life without love until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), a mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming
tagline: Find your way back

title: Ben'Imana
cast_top: Clémentine U. Nyirinkindi, Kesia Kelly Nishimwe, Arivere Kagoyire, Isabelle Kabano
overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
cast_top: Cameron Winter
overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.
tagline: On tour. On film. This fall.

title: Mysaa
cast_top: Rashmika Mandanna, Easwari Rao, Rahul Ravindran, Samuthirakani
overview: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

title: A Long Winter
cast_top: Fred Hechinger, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Caitríona Balfe, Kit Connor
overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
cast_top: Tom Sizemore, Robert LaSardo, Celine Alva, Daniel Baldwin
overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.
tagline: Hey Buck, got gravity bombs?

title: The Friend's House is Here
cast_top: Mahshad Bahram, Hana Mana, Farzad Karen, Zohreh Pirnia
overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

title: Dark Noon
cast_top: Michael Steger, Michael Barra, Rachel Spencer Hewitt, Joe Kurak
overview: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.

title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
cast_top: Mark Lewis, Mike Majlak, Sam Dale, Sam Dale
overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

title: Ash and Crayons
overview: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.
tagline: A story of innocence and resilience in the shadow of war.

title: 14th
cast_top: Sherrilyn Ifill, Stacey Abrams, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jeff Flake
overview: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

title: The Test
cast_top: Shawn Goolsby, Kirsten Wold, Lauren Parker, James Ippolito
overview: Caught between a pro bono murder investigation and a law school reunion, Mike Leonardo reconnects with classmates for a weekend to celebrate the past. But when buried secrets surface the reunion curdles into something far more dangerous.
tagline: Sometimes the Choices We Make...Unmake Us.

title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
cast_top: Soraya Akhlaghi
overview: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

title: GAME
cast_top: Marc Bessant, Jason Williamson, Alison Campbell, Nathan Benham
overview: Late summer 1993. After stealing a stash of money and drugs, aging raver David crashes his car deep in the woods - trapped in the wreckage, injured and helpless, he hangs suspended between life and death. When a mysterious poacher discovers him, no rescue comes, only a watchful, unsettling presence that seems intent on letting nature finish the job. As the hours stretch and the elements close in, a tense and claustrophobic battle of wills, and wits, unfolds - where survival hinges on outlasting both the wilderness and the predator at its edge.​
tagline: "I've watched someone die before... takes a while sometimes."

title: UK Holiday
cast_top: Kumud Pant, Atul Sharma, Bharat Mistri, Nilu Pant
overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

title: Alias Rukmini
cast_top: Nithiin, Aafiya Sayed
overview: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

title: Who Is Still Alive
cast_top: Jawdat Khoudary, Mahmoud Jouda, Adel Altaweel, Haneen Harara
overview: A map of Gaza, its towns, camps and neighbourhoods. White paint on a black ground. Within the crudely drawn outlines, nine refugees who escaped the inferno tell their stories.

title: Drinking and Driving
cast_top: Jillian Frank, Avalon Fast, Ethan Hawksworth, Henri Gillespi
overview: Early twenties Iris and Palmer never left their hometown. They work at the same restaurant, share the same bed, and both have a habit of drinking and driving. They run into Levi, a guy they used to know. They spend time with him and his cousin, Phoenix, in cars, backyards, and other people’s bedrooms. When Levi shares a dream he had with Iris things change between the four of them. The reality of the summer becomes faded, the parties die. The four end in a field of unified confusion.
tagline: Wait, I think I have been here before...

title: Transplant
cast_top: Bill Camp, Eric Nam, Michelle Okkyung Lee, April Grace
overview: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

title: Demon Dancer: Sua/Nara
cast_top: Jiyeon Han, Anita Korosi, Joseph Kim, Won Hee Lee
overview: After tragedy shatters her life, a professional ballerina allows a demon to possess her—transforming her body, movement, and rage into a deadly weapon.
tagline: Hurry demon, possess me.

title: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian
cast_top: Cara Jade Myers
overview: An Ojibwe woman is awakened to her past and its bloody aftermath.

title: Stay in the car
cast_top: Lara Hunter, Ashley Alva, Timothy V. Murphy
overview: Set against the dim glow of streetlights and the hum of passing sirens, Stay in the Car captures one night in the life of a fifteen-year-old girl waiting in her mother's El Camino and the quiet reckoning that unfolds in the stillness. Based on real events, Stay in the Car explores the fragile line between safety and survival, love and neglect. It invites audiences into a world where survival depends on silence, and one young girl must decide whether to remain in her mother's chaos or step into her own uncertain freedom.
tagline: A choice that could change her life forever.

title: Errand Guy
cast_top: Jason Levinson, Cooper Shaw, Ashley Pearson, Carol Kenley
overview: Brad, a middle-aged errand runner, gets guilt-tripped by his dead Jewish Grandmother into believing his passive life embarrasses his ancestors, so he steals a Ferrari and tries to buy a minor league baseball team behind his wife's back.

title: XI: Thou Shalt Not Be Indifferent
overview: Marian Turski, the world-renowned historian, journalist, and until his recent passing, president of the International Auschwitz Committee, takes us back to the roots of evil. A survivor of the Lodz Ghetto, Auschwitz, Buchenwald, and Theresienstadt death camps in his youth, Turski explains with firsthand knowledge and surgical precision how otherwise well-educated and cultured people can, under certain circumstances, turn into criminals and mass murderers. He reminds us about the painful past, explains the present, and warns about the future. His dramatic plea, "do not be indifferent!" remains more relevant now than ever. Andrzej Wolf, the director and cinematographer of this film, pays a loving tribute to one of the last moral compasses of the Greatest Generation.

title: Tales of Ardenmore
cast_top: David Duplechin, Bridgett Mistrot, Joe Coffey, Hondo Hendricks
overview: A brash knight-in-training must partner with the woman he spurned, on a quest to save his brother from an undead sorcerer. Together they must overcome rogue warriors, monsters and magic.

title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN KAOHSIUNG: LIVE VIEWING
overview: The record-breaking journey continues as BTS’s history-making tour across Asia makes its way to the big screen. Join the roar of the crowds in Kaohsiung in November and experience the breathtaking performances and electrifying energy of BTS’s stadium tour. Don't miss your chance to witness BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in all its glory in cinemas worldwide.

title: Precipice
overview: A profoundly working-class community with an intense connection to its land and water is transformed into a pleasure paradise for the wealthy…all while the ground slips into the sea. A feature documentary, PRECIPICE focuses on the intersection between climate change and a changing shore community’s response to this global emergency.

title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
cast_top: Soroya Clayton-Wright, Lil Champ, Loretta Robinson, Miles Caton
overview: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.
tagline: "The stardust is gleaming, the clockwork is spinning, and the magic is high."

title: Daughters of the Late Colonel
cast_top: Louise Brealey, Lucy Trodd, Simon Kunz
overview: After the death of their ill-tempered and controlling father, two middle-aged sisters find themselves at a loss.  An unexpected visitor sparks the courage in them to begin their lives anew.. ‘Daughters of the Late Colonel’ is a merry, rude, and lyrical, animated adaptation of the modernist short story of the same name, written by Katherine Mansfield in 1920.

title: Games We Play
cast_top: Margot Pitts, Casey Cott, Dylan McTee, Adam Faison
overview: Imogen accompanies her boyfriend Jack and his two childhood best friends on a weekend getaway. There, she must participate in a tournament of high-stakes games, leading her to question her sanity and her safety.

title: A Dot in the Ocean
cast_top: Heath Miller, Demi Marie Miller, Nathan Taupez Scinto
overview: A Dot in the Ocean is a gripping documentary that transports viewers to the breathtaking, vibrant shores of Utila, Honduras - until an astonishing discovery deep within the mangroves changes everything, leaving audiences questioning what lies hidden just out of sight.

title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
cast_top: Levi Bermudez, Sarah Montes, Luke Anaya, Xaveir Lopez
overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.
tagline: They ripped themselves apart. They were friends too.

title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii
cast_top: Gauri Malla, Tripti Nadakar, Rekha Thapa, Mahesh Tripathi
overview: Weary of years of neglect, a band of four complete misfits unwillingly teams up to save their village and loved ones. What ensues is absolute madness, chaos, and a riot of laughter as they defy the odds while discovering compassion, forgiveness, and friendship along the way.

title: What Happened On November 1st?
cast_top: Angelina Jackson, Grace Damiani, Simone Alexa Lupo, Ivereigh Tarateta
overview: A whole college skips the second day of Halloweekend to celebrate Christmas on November 1st. Dressing festive, watching Christmas movies and playing music. However, there's a mystery...why and how are people getting murdered on November 1st?
tagline: ...and a partridge in a pear tree

title: Vive le Punk
overview: 50 years after the British Punk explosion, this documentary follows four bands that are still active today (Sham 69, 999, Ruts DC and The Boys) and features interviews with Charlie Harper, Joe Corre, Dr. John Cooper Clarke, Gaye Advert and other Punk Rock luminaries in search for the meaning of Punk and the relevance of its message today.  With rare archival footage, explosive live performances, and an unflinching look at the punk ethos in today’s world, this film is not just a retrospective—In a world that mirrors the one Punk once railed against, is the message still relevant—or has it been consumed by commercialism?. This film should appeal to every generation of rebels, misfits, and outsiders. Punk may have started as anarchy in the streets, but it’s far from finished. Vive le Punk!

title: Sophmores
cast_top: Harper Taylor, Ellie Romney, Kai Rupert, Michael Greenleaf
overview: A group of friends fights at a "Friendsgiving".
tagline: Who are you thankful for?

title: The Jungle
cast_top: Nora Kniffen, Finn Jordan
overview: Mariah is stuck in a self-destructive cycle of partying until she reconnects with an old friend who helps her rediscover her identity.
tagline: It gets worse here every day
